articles.title: Massachusetts lesbian bar ignites fury after easing mask rules for one night a week
articles.summary: Last Ditch Bar in Greenfield, Massachusetts, faces a boycott and accusations of ableism after lifting its mask mandate on Saturdays to stay afloat.
articles.body:
A lesbian bar in Greenfield, Massachusetts, faced backlash for lifting its mask mandate on Saturdays, with accusations of ableism and calls for boycott.

The Last Ditch Bar and Arts Venue struggled financially, leading to the decision to remove the mask requirement in an attempt to increase revenue and stay afloat.

The controversy escalated as critics accused the bar of endangering disabled and immunocompromised individuals, leading to heated community meetings and ongoing tensions.

A lesbian bar in Greenfield, Massachusetts , sparked community backlash after lifting its mask mandate for one night a week, with accusations of ableism and boycott directed at the struggling business.

Last Ditch Bar and Arts Venue recently removed its mask requirement on Saturdays in an effort to boost business, but some members of the small city's queer community objected to the change, according to The Boston Globe.

Some critics accused the bar's owners of putting disabled people at risk and compared the policy change to a "mass disabling event" and a "eugenicist" attack while also wishing violence against the establishment, according to The Boston Globe.

"I hope your venue gets firebombed for robbing my fellow immunocompromised people of their Saturday plans just to scrape extra revenue from ablists [sic]," one commenter wrote on the bar's social media post announcing the change.

"People like you kill disabled people in the name of your own leisure and convenience," wrote another.

"Just say you're being complicit in a mass disabling event and get it over with," a third said.

"When y'all close, let the record state it was ableism + complying in advance, because that's what it is," another wrote.

"Does COVlD not disable people on Saturday nights?" added another user, who had a picture of himself in a mask as his profile picture.

This comes years after the COVID-19 pandemic was declared over by the federal government in 2023. State and local governments, as well as most businesses across the country, had also lifted masking requirements several years ago.

Additionally, Greenfield had not reported a COVID-19 case in more than two months, according to The Boston Globe.

The bar has been sparsely attended on what would normally be busy Saturday nights as some angered customers have called for a boycott, according to The Boston Globe.

The backlash came as the bar was already struggling financially under to the bar's unusual business model that includes rules such as "Nobody will be barred from entry due to lack of funds."

Last Ditch also had the mask mandate in place as part of a policy intended to make the space accessible to disabled and immunocompromised patrons, meaning the face covering requirement was designed to protect anyone who was immunocompromised.

Customers were told that they were expected to mask up unless they were actively taking a bite of food or a sip of a drink.

The bar's owners began to fall behind on their bills and were unable to pay themselves or even their staff.

Jackie Matellian, the remaining owner involved in daily operations, lived in her truck for six months, working four jobs and carrying a $50,000 loan, according to The Boston Globe.

The two other owners stepped back from daily operations months ago, including one who had enrolled in clown school and another who is a drag performer using it/its pronouns.

Because of the financial woes, the bar decided to lift the mask mandate on Saturdays to increase revenue and keep the business afloat, The Boston Globe reported.

"It is with love we inform our immunocompromised disabled divas we will be opening Saturday nights as mask optional," Last Ditch wrote on an August Instagram post that ignited the backlash.

The bar first attempted to ease tensions and apologize for its post, writing: "We are sorry for our passive and dismissive tone of our change to the norms and schedule impacting the most intersectional of us. We understand everyone faces different intersections and we are always working to consider all needs fully."

But that did little to lower the temperature, as critics said Last Ditch's post failed to include written "alt text," a short written description of an image added to the HTML code of a webpage for visually impaired people.

"This is not an accessible post," one person commented. "It indicates the lack of care or interest in Disability intersectionality."

Last Ditch again sought to address the controversy during its monthly community meeting on Sept. 11, according to The Boston Globe.

Outraged attendees who were joined by Zoom began flooding the chat with comments that were read aloud for the in-person group to hear.

The meeting took another twist when critics made an allegation of racism because the mediator, a licensed therapist, was white.

"A lot of people are calling for an acknowledgment of harm and I'm hearing a WHITE therapist … center[ing] the feelings of a majority white and white adjacent staff," one person said, the newspaper reported.

Attendees also took issue with a therapist being there at all and said it made them feel "widely unsafe" since that made the woman a mandated reporter, meaning she is required by law to report known or suspected abuse.

Matellian broke down in tears when it was her turn to speak, saying she was only trying to help her friends with the bar before taking over once they left and having a difficult time trying to survive financially.

Matellian has fallen behind on rent and the bar's landlord wants $3,900 by the end of September.

"It was not my passion project," Matellian cried while masked up. "I never really wanted this. I don't think I'm doing a very good job."

But the bar's critics had no sympathy for the struggling business owner.

"You chose to use your time to spill tears and center your feelings," one person responded. "This is incredibly racist and deflecting behavior."

The mask-optional Saturday nights have not helped with business, as the barroom has been nearly empty each weekend despite drink deals and DJs that would attract dozens of customers in the past.

One person recently suggested having a Lady Gaga-themed party to pull in more patrons.

"Gaga is canceled," the bartender said. "Gaga is Zionist."

À noite, em Porto Velho (RO), o candidato participou de reuniões com lideranças no bairro Marcos Freire e com apoiadores no bairro São Francisco. Ele também se reuniu com representantes dos setores de cultura e esporte, com membros da maçonaria e finalizou a agenda em reuniões e encontros com lideranças e apoiadores.

articles.title: Renan Santos quer mudar divisão de recursos entre estados | G1
articles.standfirst: Em Piracicaba (SP), candidato à presidência criticou o atual pacto federativo e disse que pretende reter mais recursos em estados com melhores resultados.
articles.summary: Em Piracicaba, Renan Santos criticou a atual divisão de recursos federais e defendeu metas de desempenho para estados e municípios no pacto federativo.
articles.body:
Renan Santos (Missão) durante entrevista em lanchonete de São Carlos (SP) — Foto: Rodrigo Sargaço/EPTV

O candidato Renan Santos (Missão) afirmou, nesta quinta-feira (24), que pretende alterar como os recursos federais são distribuídos entre os estados brasileiros. Durante um evento na praça José Bonifácio, no centro de Piracicaba (SP), ele criticou o atual modelo do pacto federativo.

Pacto federativo: conjunto de regras constitucionais que define a divisão de poderes, competências e recursos financeiros entre a União, os estados, o Distrito Federal e os municípios.

Questionado sobre o fato de São Paulo ser o estado que 'mais arrecada e o que menos recebe', o candidato propôs a criação de metas na execução do orçamento público. Segundo ele, atualmente o governo federal repassa dinheiro de forma desproporcional para estados que não atingem resultados.

"Hoje, a lógica do governo federal é a seguinte: se você é um governador vagabundo, que não trabalha bem, que não protege as pessoas, que não melhora a educação, você recebe mais dinheiro", declara.

A proposta de Renan é reter mais recursos em estados que 'pagam a conta'. Ele citou São Paulo, Santa Catarina e Minas Gerais.

"Nós vamos premiar quem vai bem e nós vamos punir quem vai mal, em seus municípios e em seus estados", afirma.

Renan ainda focou nas propostas para o comércio. Ele se posicionou contra o fim da escala de trabalho 6x1, afirmando que a medida fecharia comércios e geraria desemprego e informalidade.

Para fomentar o setor, Renan prometeu cortar R$ 250 bilhões em gastos do governo federal, mirando no que chamou de "mamata de político, de judiciário, de militar".

Segundo ele, a redução de despesas forçará a queda da taxa de juros, que hoje classificou como "extorsiva" e de "agiota", permitindo a oferta de crédito barato para os lojistas investirem em seus negócios.

articles.body:
O sorteio do concurso 3.062 da Mega-Sena foi realizado na noite desta quinta-feira (24), em São Paulo. O prêmio para as apostas que acertassem as seis dezenas era de R$ 37 milhões . No entanto, ninguém levou a faixa principal o valor acumulou para R$ 45 milhões .

5 acertos: 86 apostas ganhadoras, R$ 19.736,75

4 acertos: 5.065 apostas ganhadoras, R$ 552,38

O g1 passou a transmitir, desde abril, todos os sorteios das Loterias Caixa, ao vivo . A transmissão começa momentos antes de cada dia de concursos, no site e no canal do g1 no YouTube .

Resultado do concurso 3062 da Mega-Sena. — Foto: Reprodução/Caixa

A aposta mínima custa R$ 6 e pode ser realizada também pela internet, até as 20h – saiba como fazer a sua aposta online .

Os jogos podem ser realizados até as 20h (horário de Brasília) em qualquer lotérica do país ou por meio do site e aplicativo Loterias Caixa, disponíveis em smartphones, computadores e outros dispositivos.

Já os bolões digitais poderão ser comprados até as 20h30, exclusivamente pelo portal Loterias Online e pelo aplicativo.

O pagamento da aposta online pode ser realizado via PIX, cartão de crédito ou pelo internet banking, para correntistas da Caixa. É preciso ter 18 anos ou mais para participar.

A Mega tem três sorteios semanais: às terças, quintas e domingos .

A probabilidade de vencer em cada concurso varia de acordo com o número de dezenas jogadas e o tipo de aposta realizada. Para um jogo simples, com apenas seis dezenas, que custa R$ 6, a probabilidade de ganhar o prêmio milionário é de 1 em 50.063.860, segundo a Caixa.

Já para uma aposta com 20 dezenas (limite máximo), com o preço de R$ 232.560,00, a probabilidade de acertar o prêmio é de 1 em 1.292, ainda de acordo com a instituição.

articles.body:
Candidato ao governo do Amapá, Clécio Luís. — Foto: Isadora Pereira/g1

O candidato à reeleição ao governo do Amapá, Clécio Luís ( União Brasil ), cumpriu quatro agendas de campanha nesta quinta-feira (24), em Macapá e Santana .

Pela manhã, o candidato realizou uma caminhada no distrito da Fazendinha e participou de um treinamento em Santana . À tarde, cumpriu agenda administrativa e se reuniu com a coordenação de campanha.

articles.summary: Orleans afirmou que pretende usar incentivos fiscais, a Zona de Processamento de Exportação e a exploração da Margem Equatorial para ampliar a geração de emprego e renda no estado.
articles.body:
O candidato ao Governo do Maranhão, Orleans Brandão ( MDB ), cumpriu agenda de campanha nesta quinta-feira (24) na região noroeste do estado. Acompanhado de apoiadores, ele participou de motociata pelas cidades de Central, Guimarães , Mirinzal e Cedral , onde falou sobre propostas para o desenvolvimento econômico.

Além da agenda de campanha, Orleans apresentou propostas para atrair novas indústrias, gerar empregos e ampliar a distribuição de renda no Maranhão.

Orleans afirmou que pretende atrair indústrias por meio de incentivos fiscais. Entre as propostas citadas pelo candidato estão a Zona de Processamento de Exportação e a exploração da Margem Equatorial, que, segundo ele, podem contribuir para a geração de empregos e o desenvolvimento econômico do estado.

“O Maranhão vem avançando muito no nosso desenvolvimento econômico, crescemos 5% no primeiro trimestre de 2026 e vamos continuar avançando, atraindo indústrias, empregos e empresas para dentro do nosso estado, gerando emprego, renda e oportunidades. Através da nossa zona de processamento e exportação, vamos gerar mais de 30 mil novos empregos. E vamos girar mais de 30 bilhões de reais. Vou também, através do Congresso Federal, garantir que a gente faça exploração da margem equatorial e fazendo a exploração de petróleo e de gás. É uma virada de chave no Estado do Maranhão e vamos, com certeza, através desses dois investimentos, trazer um desenvolvimento econômico gigantesco para o nosso Estado. Mas também vou fazer qualificação profissional, vou atrair indústrias para cá através de incentivos fiscais. O meu foco no governo será gerar emprego e renda”, disse o candidato.

As eleições de 2026 serão realizadas em 4 de outubro, no primeiro turno. Caso seja necessário, o segundo turno ocorrerá em 25 de outubro para os cargos de presidente da República e governador.

Na votação, os eleitores escolherão candidatos aos cargos de deputado estadual, deputado federal, dois senadores, governador e presidente.

articles.title: Avenida Santos Dumont vai ser liberada após 12 anos de interdição | G1
articles.standfirst: O trecho desbloqueado fica entre as ruas Dona Leopoldina e Nogueira Acioli, nas proximidades do Colégio Militar de Fortaleza.
articles.summary: O trecho desbloqueado nesta sexta fica entre as ruas Dona Leopoldina e Nogueira Acioli, nas proximidades do Colégio Militar de Fortaleza.
articles.body:
A Avenida Santos Dumont vai ser completamente liberada , em Fortaleza, nesta sexta-feira (25). A via teve, pelo menos, um trecho bloqueado nos últimos 12 anos devido a obras da linha leste do Metrô de Fortaleza .

O trecho desbloqueado nesta sexta fica entre as ruas Dona Leopoldina e Nogueira Acioli, nas proximidades do Colégio Militar de Fortaleza. A liberação vai ser realizada pela Secretaria da Infraestrutura do Ceará (Seinfra).

O Governo do Ceará disse que a conclusão da linha leste está prevista para 2028. O trecho do Metrofor terá 7,3 quilômetros de extensão, totalmente subterrâneos, conectando o Centro de Fortaleza ao Papicu em cerca de 15 minutos, com capacidade para transportar até 150 mil pessoas por dia.

Conforme o governo, o projeto prevê integração com todas as linhas do Metrô de Fortaleza e com o terminal de ônibus do Papicu.

Além da liberação da via, veículos de imprensa terão acesso à Estação Colégio Militar, onde será possível acompanhar os trabalhos no subsolo e conhecer de perto os túneis que já foram concluídos.

Avenida Santos Dumont vai ser liberada em Fortaleza após 12 anos de interdição. — Foto: Paulo Alberto/TVM

articles.title: Araceli Lemos quer reestruturar Cohab e ampliar moradias no Pará | G1
articles.standfirst: Candidata do PSOL ao Governo do Estado cumpriu agenda de campanha com lideranças de movimentos por moradia no Tapanã, em Belém, nesta quinta-feira, 24.
articles.summary: Araceli Lemos propõe reestruturar a Cohab e entregar 30 mil moradias populares no Pará em reunião com movimentos sociais no Tapanã, em Belém.
articles.body:
A candidata do PSOL ao Governo do Pará, Araceli Lemos , disse nesta quinta-feira (24) que planeja reestruturar a companhia de habitação a nível estadual para garantir a entrega de moradias e reduzir o déficit habitacional no estado.

"Nós queremos em quatro anos chegar a 30.000 unidades habitacionais entregando pro povo nessa parceria com o Governo Federal, mas também desapropriando áreas para entregar para a construção coletiva", afirmou.

Araceli cumpriu agenda acompanhada da candidata a vice-governadora, Fátima Santana. Elas se reuniram com lideranças do Movimento de Trabalhadores Sem Teto (MTST), do Viver Pratinha e de outras mobilizações populares por moradia.

Araceli Lemos propõe reestruturar companhia de habitação e ampliar moradias populares no Pará. — Foto: Reprodução/TV Liberal

O encontro foi realizado em um espaço no bairro do Tapanã, em Belém , para debater a habitação no Pará e defender a moradia como um direito básico para a garantia do bem-viver da população.

Durante a reunião, a candidata apresentou propostas para o setor, como a promoção da habitação social em imóveis e terrenos ociosos do estado, além do fortalecimento da relação com o governo federal e prefeituras no programa Minha Casa, Minha Vida.

Segundo a candidata, o déficit no estado é de pelo menos 400 mil moradias, concentrando-se principalmente na Região Metropolitana de Belém, que soma 170 mil unidades de déficit.

Araceli propôs a reestruturação da Companhia de Habitação do Estado do Pará (Cohab) e a reformulação do programa "Sua Casa" para que os recursos sejam destinados à construção de novas unidades, e não apenas para reformas.

"Portanto, nosso governo tem esse compromisso com aqueles que precisam", declarou Araceli.

A candidata do PSOL também propôs a criação de uma linha de crédito habitacional direcionada a mulheres que são mães solo, mães atípicas e vítimas de violência.

A agenda de propostas também prevê a integração da habitação às políticas de adaptação climática. Entre as medidas apresentadas estão o fomento à instalação de painéis de energia solar em projetos de moradia de interesse social e a implantação de um programa para intervenções em baixadas e encostas, com o objetivo de conter riscos e regenerar áreas degradadas.

articles.title: Alunos desenvolvem trilha que une escola, cultivo e mata nativa em MT | G1
articles.standfirst: Iniciativa no assentamento PDS Doze de Outubro, em Cláudia (MT), prevê plantio de 100 mudas nativas, capacitação de alunos e observação da fauna.
articles.summary: Iniciativa no assentamento PDS Doze de Outubro, em Cláudia (MT), prevê plantio de 100 mudas nativas, capacitação de alunos e observação da da fauna.
articles.body:
A iniciativa voltada ao desenvolvimento de trilhas ecológicas também prevê recuperação da vegetação, educação ambiental e capacitação dos alunos. — Foto: Natureza por Toda Parte - Trilhas Ecológicas

Alunos da Escola Estadual Florestan Fernandes, no Projeto de Desenvolvimento Sustentável (PDS) Doze de Outubro, em Cláudia (MT) , participam de um projeto para criar uma trilha ecológica que deve conectar a escola, sistemas agroflorestais, uma área de produção de castanha e um fragmento de mata com nascente. A iniciativa também prevê recuperação da vegetação, educação ambiental e capacitação dos alunos para identificar espécies da fauna e da flora.

O projeto Natureza por Toda Parte – Trilhas Ecológicas começou como uma iniciativa escolar em 2025 e segue em andamento. Atualmente, a proposta tem duração prevista de 12 meses e pretende beneficiar diretamente 200 pessoas de 50 famílias e outras mil de forma indireta. O PDS Doze de Outubro tem 6.180 hectares e, segundo o documento do projeto, reúne cerca de 140 famílias.

A proposta prevê o plantio de 100 mudas nativas nos trechos de capim que serão revegetados, além da instalação de placas educativas e pontos de parada ao longo do percurso. Os estudantes também devem participar de oficinas para aprender a identificar espécies e utilizar ferramentas de mapeamento e registro da vegetação.

Segundo Maria Sofia , de 17 anos, aluna do 2º ano do ensino médio e uma das estudantes que participam da iniciativa, o projeto começou a partir de uma atividade escolar chamada Restaura Natureza. Com o interesse dos alunos, a proposta continuou sob o nome Natureza por Toda Parte – Trilhas Ecológicas.

“Eu faço um pouco de tudo, principalmente as apresentações e a metodologia do projeto. Foi uma experiência que me ensinou muito mais do que apenas a teoria em sala de aula”, contou.

Maria disse que o grupo começou com cinco estudantes, mas dois acabaram deixando a iniciativa. Atualmente, três alunos permanecem no projeto. Ela participou das atividades de plantio próximas à nascente e afirmou que essa foi uma das experiências mais marcantes da iniciativa.

“Me marcou participar diretamente da recuperação da área, no caso, plantar as mudas perto da área da nascente. Ver de perto as mudanças e perceber que nosso trabalho está ajudando a natureza tornou a experiência muito especial”, afirmou.

A professora e coordenadora do projeto, Cleonice de Paula , explicou que o percurso pensado para a trilha tem aproximadamente 3 km e passa por diferentes áreas do assentamento até chegar à nascente. No projeto apresentado ao Fundo Casa, porém, a previsão é de implantação de pelo menos 700 metros de trilha, conectando a escola, a área de produção de castanha, sistemas agroflorestais e o fragmento de mata com nascente.

A proposta é que o percurso também seja utilizado em atividades de educação ambiental e, futuramente, para receber visitantes interessados na observação da fauna.

O projeto prevê a capacitação de 10 alunos para identificação de espécies e uso de ferramentas de monitoramento e mapeamento. Também está prevista uma visita-piloto para observação da fauna, além da elaboração de um manual de boas práticas para turistas.

Maria disse que o grupo começou com cinco estudantes, mas dois acabaram deixando a iniciativa. Atualmente, três alunos permanecem no projeto. — Foto: Natureza por Toda Parte - Trilhas Ecológicas

O trabalho também tem relação com iniciativas de conservação de primatas na região. Segundo Christine Steiner , bióloga e diretora-executiva do Instituto Ecótono , a proposta de implantação de um corredor florestal no PDS Doze de Outubro pode beneficiar a fauna local, especialmente primatas.

O Instituto Ecótono auxilia tecnicamente a iniciativa e, de acordo com Christine, o projeto foi inspirado em um trabalho de restauração realizado no assentamento rural, Gleba Mercedes (Projeto de Assentamento Weslei Manoel dos Santos), em Sinop , a 503 km de Cuiabá, onde um corredor florestal foi plantado para conectar fragmentos de mata.

Na Gleba Mercedes, o corredor implantado em 2024 já apresenta mudanças na vegetação. Segundo Christine, algumas árvores alcançaram entre 3 e 4 metros de altura, e espécies como cajueiro e mamoninha-do-mato começaram a produzir frutos em 2026. A área continua sendo monitorada.

Os zogue-zogues-de-mato-grosso que vivem em um fragmento próximo ainda não utilizam o corredor. O primata está classificada na categoria Criticamente em Perigo de extinção, conforme classificação da União Internacional para a Conservação da Natureza (UICN). Segundo a bióloga, atualmente seis animais são monitorados em uma área de aproximadamente quatro hectares.

Christine explicou que a espécie depende de árvores mais altas e de copas interligadas para utilizar esse tipo de conexão. Segundo ela, a expectativa é que os macacos passem a utilizar o corredor entre sete e oito anos após o plantio, quando a vegetação atingir as condições necessárias.

Enquanto os zogue-zogues ainda não utilizam a área, insetos e aves já passaram a ocupar o corredor, segundo Christine. De acordo com a bióloga, flores e frutos produzidos pelas plantas servem de alimento para esses animais e indicam que o corredor já é utilizado por parte da fauna.

A experiência da Gleba Mercedes também é apontada pelo Instituto Ecótono como um modelo que pode ser reproduzido em outras áreas. A instituição afirma que pretende mapear novos locais para implantação de corredores e busca recursos para ampliar o trabalho, com a meta de chegar a dez propriedades até 2030.

No PDS Doze de Outubro, o projeto pretende envolver estudantes, agricultores e moradores no acompanhamento da vegetação, na identificação da fauna e na recuperação de trechos degradados. A iniciativa também prevê preparar a comunidade para receber visitantes e gerar renda complementar a partir da observação da fauna e de produtos da floresta.

articles.title: Desigualdade em Minas Gerais: fome atinge 4,4 milhões de pessoas | G1
articles.standfirst: Em 2024, 4,4 milhões de pessoas viviam com algum grau de insegurança alimentar no estado. Dados sobre renda e habitação revelam diferenças entre municípios e dentro da Grande BH.
articles.summary: A desigualdade em Minas Gerais afeta 4,4 milhões com insegurança alimentar e gera déficit habitacional, expondo o abismo de renda entre os municípios mineiros.
articles.body:
Assim como o Brasil, Minas Gerais reúne realidades muito diferentes. O estado tem indicadores de desenvolvimento próximos à média nacional, mas há grandes diferenças de renda entre os municípios do estado. Em 2024, 4,4 milhões de mineiros viviam com algum grau de insegurança alimentar, e o déficit habitacional ultrapassava meio milhão de moradias.

O Índice de Desenvolvimento Humano Municipal (IDHM), que considera renda, educação e expectativa de vida, foi de 0,809 em Minas, enquanto a média brasileira foi de 0,805. Já os dados de renda mostram a distância entre municípios mineiros: em Nova Lima, o rendimento domiciliar por pessoa era mais de sete vezes o registrado em Monte Formoso.

Reduzir essas diferenças e ampliar o acesso à alimentação e à moradia estão entre os desafios de quem assumir o governo de Minas Gerais em 2027.

Imagem aérea de Belo Horizonte — Foto: Reprodução/TV Globo

Segundo dados do IBGE referentes a 2024, 454 mil mineiros viviam em situação de insegurança alimentar grave, condição em que a fome faz parte da rotina. O número de pessoas com algum grau de insegurança alimentar caiu cerca de 10% em relação a 2023, mas ainda chegava a 4,4 milhões.

Em Contagem, na Região Metropolitana de Belo Horizonte, Eliana Barbosa de Souza vive com o marido e os três filhos em um cômodo de 12 metros quadrados. A família se mudou para o espaço há cinco meses, depois que um incêndio destruiu a casa de madeira onde morava, na ocupação Guarani Kaiowá.

Eliana conta que o vento entra pelas frestas das paredes e que os filhos enfrentam problemas de saúde nos períodos de frio. Ela já pensou em reformar a casa, mas diz que o dinheiro não é suficiente para comprar material de construção e garantir a alimentação da família.

“Quando você pensa em comprar o material, ou você compra, ou você come. Se você compra, você não põe na mesa. Como é que você deixa seus filhos passar a necessidade?”

Eliana Barbosa de Souza vive com o marido e os três filhos em um cômodo de 12 metros quadrados — Foto: Reprodução/TV Globo

Na mesma ocupação, Sandra Maria Miranda mora há 19 anos em uma casa de madeira. Ela relata problemas na estrutura do imóvel e diz que a renda dela e do marido não é suficiente para abastecer a casa. Segundo Sandra, a família recebe uma cesta básica e, quando possível, busca alimentos distribuídos por uma igreja.

Dados do Censo de 2022 mostram que o rendimento domiciliar mensal por pessoa em Nova Lima, na Grande BH, era de R$ 4.299,91, o maior do país. Em Monte Formoso, no Vale do Jequitinhonha, o valor era de R$ 590,22, o menor de Minas. Na Região Metropolitana de Belo Horizonte, a média era de R$ 2.112,11.

O rendimento domiciliar per capita é calculado pela divisão da renda dos moradores de uma casa pelo número de pessoas que vivem nela.

Para a professora do Departamento de Demografia da UFMG Danielle Fernandes, a melhora dos indicadores gerais não significa que todas as regiões tenham avançado na mesma proporção.

“Enquanto não tiver um esforço grande para a diminuição da desigualdade, a gente vai continuar crescendo, elevando a média”, afirma.

As diferenças também aparecem dentro da Grande BH. Segundo os dados citados pelo geógrafo Rodrigo Carvalho, do Instituto de Geociências da UFMG, 12% da população da região metropolitana vivia em situação de pobreza e 2%, em extrema pobreza, apesar de a região estar entre as de maior rendimento do país.

Em Belo Horizonte, mais de 13% da população — cerca de 300 mil pessoas — morava em favelas, conforme os dados do Censo de 2022 apresentados pelo pesquisador. Para ele, essas áreas precisam de maior atenção das políticas públicas, especialmente no acesso a saneamento e outros serviços essenciais.

Em 2024, o déficit habitacional de Minas Gerais era de 506.419 moradias, o equivalente a 6,3% do total de domicílios. No Brasil, a proporção era de 7,4%.

O cálculo reúne habitações precárias, situações em que famílias precisam dividir uma mesma moradia e casos em que o aluguel compromete uma parcela elevada da renda. Em Minas, o peso excessivo do aluguel respondia pela maior parte do déficit, com 386.025 registros.

Para famílias como a de Eliana, as dificuldades para melhorar a moradia se somam às despesas com alimentação. A desigualdade social e os desafios que ela representa para o próximo governo do estado são tema de mais uma reportagem da série Minas Brasil, exibida pelo MG2.

articles.title: Trabalhadores dos Correios na PB decidem pelo fim da greve | G1
articles.standfirst: Greve começou no dia 11 de setembro e, após assembleia de trabalhadores nesta quinta-feira (24), ficou decidido volta aos trabalhos na sexta-feira (25).
articles.summary: A greve dos Correios na Paraíba termina após assembleia do Sintect-PB nesta quinta-feira (24), com retorno das atividades previsto para a sexta-feira (25).
articles.body:
Agência dos Correios no campus sede da UFPB, em João Pessoa — Foto: TV Cabo Branco/Reprodução

Os trabalhadores dos Correios na Paraíba decidiram, nesta quinta-feira (24), encerrar a greve que começou no dia 11 de setembro . A informação foi confirmada pelo Sindicato dos Trabalhadores em Correios e Telégrafos na Paraíba (Sintect-PB).

A categoria decidiu pelo fim da greve durante uma assembleia. Nesta quinta-feira (24), houve um julgamento do dissídio coletivo da categoria. A expecativa é de que os trabalhos, com o fim da greve, sejam retomados a partir da sexta-feira (25).

A paralisação no estado foi uma adesão ao movimento nacional da categoria e foi definida após uma assembleia realizada no dia 10 de setembro, em João Pessoa e Campina Grande .

Segundo o presidente do Sindicato dos Trabalhadores em Correios e Telégrafos da Paraíba (Sintect-PB), Tony Sérgio , durante a paralisação apenas os serviços internos administrativos estavam funcionando.

Entre as principais reivindicações da categoria estavam a recomposição salarial diante das perdas inflacionárias, a manutenção de benefícios e melhorias na assistência à saúde. Os trabalhadores também são contrários ao desmonte e à reestruturação da empresa.

articles.title: Ms Rachel doubles down on Gaza advocacy, targets ‘uncancellable’ celebrities for staying silent
articles.summary: Ms. Rachel challenged "uncancellable" celebrities on Ilana Glazer's podcast, asking why stars with secure careers won't speak out for Palestinian children.
articles.body: Children's YouTube star Ms. Rachel doubled down on her Gaza advocacy Thursday, criticizing "uncancellable" celebrities who have stayed silent about Palestinian children and questioning why stars with secure careers would not "risk something" to help save lives. Accurso, whose full name is Rachel Griffin Accurso, appeared on comedian Ilana Glazer's "It's Open" podcast to directly challenge major celebrities who have avoided taking public positions on the war. "If you are so famous, and you’re uncancellable, and you’re so famous, and you won’t even say like, ‘Kids in Gaza should have schools, people in Gaza should have hospitals.’ Like you won't say something so basic and like why can't you risk something to help save lives," Accurso said. MS RACHEL DEFENDS HER ACTIVISM BY POINTING TO MISTER ROGERS' POLITICAL LEGACY ON CHILDREN'S TV Accurso’s latest remarks came after Rabbi Yaakov Menken, executive vice president of the Coalition for Jewish Values, recently told Fox News Digital that he believed the amount of attention she devotes to Palestinian children compared to children suffering elsewhere was disproportionate. "When 0.09% of starving children receive 90% of her attention, something is wrong," Menken said. Elizabeth Barcohana, the California Republican Party’s Jewish engagement chair, also criticized Accurso in a statement to Fox News Digital last week after the children’s entertainer accused celebrities and leaders who had remained silent about Gaza of applying a racial double standard. "Ms. Rachel is essentially sanitizing terrorism with false and misleading information to emotionally manipulate her very impressionable following," Barcohana said. MS RACHEL CLAIMS 'NO ONE NEEDS A BILLION DOLLARS,' ENDORSES DEMOCRATIC PROGRESSIVES ABDUL EL-SAYED, CORI BUSH Accurso broadened her criticism beyond Gaza during the podcast to other humanitarian issues, saying she was frustrated with prominent figures who did not publicly address them. "I am really upset that people aren't speaking out about kids in detention and aren't speaking out about Gaza and Sudan and everything," Accurso said. The conversation began with Glazer raising rapper Mackelmore's removal from Ed Sheeran's U.S. tour following his onstage "Free Palestine" remarks. Accurso dismissed Sheeran by name before broadening her criticism. articles.title: Catherine Zeta-Jones bases Kill Jackie role on people she knows
articles.summary: Zeta-Jones plays Jackie Price, a former cocaine dealer who is targeted by assassins, in Kill Jackie.
articles.body:
Actor Catherine Zeta-Jones says she based her performance in the new series Kill Jackie on people she knows in Wales.

The Mumbles star plays Jackie Price, a former cocaine dealer who is being targeted by hitmen, in a new series for Prime.

It is the first time she has played a role using her Swansea accent and the first time she has filmed a drama in Wales.

"I played on people I know in Wales, people who are comedic and the accent makes it funny and real and true, but the character comes from a tough side of Swansea, which we do have as well," she said.

The series is based on a book called The Price You Pay, set in the US, and the central character is a man called Jack.

Zeta-Jones said they "flipped it" for her to be a woman with all the quirkiness and craziness that Jack had in the book.

She said: "I told my creative team, I want to play her Welsh. And they went OK."

"For many reasons. One, I've never played real Welsh Swansea ever, never shot in Wales and I think it would ground me in her character and add nuances that I would know," she told Lucy Owen on BBC Radio Wales .

"I'm so glad I did it because she's such a great character and I just wanted her to be Welsh."

Zeta-Jones, also an executive producer on the series, said she had an idea for one scene to use a song by Welsh singing legend Tom Jones, and have him help save the day.

She said: "Jackie has installed this high-tech security system behind these Andy Warhol style prints of Tom Jones. They lift up and out come very dangerous machine-guns that do the bad guys in."

"That was my contribution to the scene."

Catherine said she did not know if Jones realised he had such a crucial role and said she needed to text him to tell him about it.

"I think because I'm playing such a badass, I think he's going to love that we used his song in that particular moment in the show," she said.

Zeta-Jones has been praised by fans for using her Welsh accent in the thriller, which begins on 2 October.

One fan said they loved hearing the "queen of Wales sounding Welsh".

She has previously spoken about her strong connection to Wales , adding in her heart she "never really left".

One fan commented on an Instagram post of the trailer, saying: "Her Welsh is out and I love it, can't wait".

Speaking on BBC Woman's Hour , Zeta-Jones said she "could not believe" how many of her fans noticed the use of her accent and that it had made her "very happy".

The Hollywood actress also revisited comments she made recently about the term "nepo baby", which she said was a "horrific" phrase .

During the interview, she said her husband Michael Douglas - son of Hollywood legend Kirk Douglas - was "the ultimate nepo baby".

She also said her children Dylan and Carys had dealt with the "intense attention thrown on them profoundly well".

Despite her Welsh pride, Zeta-Jones has also revealed that she turned down an appearance on Welcome To Wrexham, alongside fellow Hollywood stars Ryan Reynolds and Rob Mac.

In an interview with Heart Radio she said she was asked several times to feature in the documentary series.

"It's really hard to explain to Americans that I'm from Swansea and I was brought up with Swansea City. My uncle Bobby was director of the Swans when John Toshack took us to the premiership."

"I was in the front seat of the parade. I have been a lifelong Swansea city fan. I can't go to Wrexham. I can't even go to Wrexham to tell them how much I love Swansea. I think they would throw bricks at me in the street", she joked.

articles.title: Shooting outside Canadian synagogue was 'hate-motivated', officials say
articles.summary: Const Jeff Smith, who was critically injured in the incident, continued to fend off the attacker after being shot multiple times, police said.
articles.body:
Canadian authorities have confirmed a shooting near a synagogue in Belleville, Ontario, was a "hate-motivated" attack targeting the Jewish community.

The shooting took place outside the Sons of Jacob Synagogue on Sunday night during Yom Kippur, the holiest night in the Jewish calendar.

Belleville police chief Murray Rodd said during a Thursday news conference that it was "a deliberate attack directed at members of the Jewish community".

A police officer who was critically injured in the incident continued to fend off the attacker despite being shot multiple times, the police chief said.

The officer, identified as Constable Jeff Smith, suffered multiple gunshot wounds to his head and body, Rodd said. Smith remains in hospital and is expected to undergo multiple surgeries related to "serious head trauma".

"He's making progress every day," the chief said.

Smith was shot in his car but sought to fend off the attack on the synagogue until a second officer arrived almost three minutes later.

"Despite suffering life-threatening injuries, within moments of encountering the armed suspect, Constable Smith exited his vehicle and engaged the attacker," Rodd said.

The second officer, Constable Mike McCurdy, "joined the active gunfight, helping to bring the violent attack to an end", the police chief said. McCrudy was not injured.

Both officers discharged their firearms, authorities said earlier this week.

Around 20 to 30 shots were fired, leaving the suspect in life-threatening condition and Smith in critical but stable condition.

The gunman was identified by police as 29-year-old Sean Ward from Quinte West, a community near Belleville and about 170km (105 miles) east of Toronto. He was sent to hospital with serious injuries and later died.

Rodd called the attempted attack a "hate-motivated crime".

Toronto police have increased patrols outside synagogues and places of worship out of an abundance of caution.

Leaders of the Jewish community, as well as Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney and other politicians, condemned antisemitic violence in the aftermath of the incident.

Noah Shack, CEO of the Centre for Israel and Jewish Affairs, said in a statement on Thursday that "if not for the extraordinary bravery of Constable Jeff Smith, Canadians would have experienced the type of mass-casualty terror attack our security services have warned is a realistic possibility".

He called on Canadian leaders to "take urgent and concrete actions" against threats toward the Jewish community.

Carney wrote on X earlier this week that "Jewish people must be able to worship safely. To live free, open, proud Jewish lives."

articles.body: NEW DELHI: CBI on Thursday arrested Abhishek Kumar, a key accused in the Mahadev online betting and gambling case in which Enforcement Directorate (ED) has claimed that the perpetrators of the illegal activities have so far generated and laundered proceeds of crime of more than Rs 94,000 crore.Kumar was deported from the UAE and taken into custody by CBI immediately after he arrived at Hyderabad airport from Dubai. More than Rs 1,000 crore has been invested in Indian share markets through foreign portfolio investments (FPIs), the agency said. It estimated that in the last few years, the accused generated more than Rs 11,000 crore annually from illegal online gambling and betting activities.Based on analysis of various seized digital evidence and statements of several accused, ED said that "it can be estimated that proceeds of crime worth Rs 11,400 crore (approx) must have been generated by illegal operations of Mahadev online book every year". articles.title: Drumcree: Decision to be reached soon over parade on Garvaghy Road
articles.summary: The Parades Commission has been deliberating on whether the parade will be allowed along the Garvaghy Road in Portadown.
articles.body:
A decision on whether or not a controversial Drumcree parade by the Orange Order in Portadown is to be re-routed may be announced later on Friday.

The Parades Commission has been deliberating since Wednesday on whether the parade will be allowed along the mainly nationalist Garvaghy Road.

Unionist politicians have urged the five-person commission to permit Sunday's march in spite of opposition from a group of local residents.

The commission has indicated it hopes to announce its decision on Friday, but it could come on Saturday.

The parade by Portadown District Orange Order is due to start at 13:00 BST at Drumcree church on Sunday and finish at Carleton Street in the town centre by 14:30.

A total of 60 people would march along the road in silence, without any bands.

The last time the commission considered the parade route, it re-routed the march, but that decision in June was later quashed in court as proper procedures had not been followed.

The commission's decision, known as a determination, was explained in a nine-page document.

A lengthy explanation is expected to accompany the latest determination.

The decision could face a legal challenge. The reasons behind the determination are likely to be outlined in detail.

Final submissions were made this week by the Orange Order and the Garvaghy Road Residents Coalition as well as all of the major political parties in Northern Ireland.

The police were also consulted about the planned parade.

The Police Service of Northern Ireland says it has activated "mutual aid arrangements to support contingency planning for a policing operation" in Portadown on Sunday.

The Parades Commission, led by Professor Evelyn Collins, has been in the political spotlight since its previous Drumcree determination was quashed in the High Court.

A review of the commission has since been ordered by the Northern Ireland Office.

The Drumcree parade dispute began in the mid-1990s and it almost derailed the peace process at the time.

Violence related to the dispute resulted in riots, roadblocks and murders.

When the Orange Order was prevented by police from walking down the route in July 1995 there was a tense stand-off. It was the same for the next three years.

The Parades Commission began operating in 1998 to regulate parades and try to defuse tension around marches.

Its decision not to allow a march down the Garvaghy Road that summer has been challenged by the order for the past three decades.

articles.title: UK summer 2026: BBC postcode lookup shows how hot and dry it was
articles.summary: Most of us experienced drought and heatwaves - but temperatures and rainfall were not the same everywhere.
articles.body:
The UK faced its hottest summer on record this year, with much of the country experiencing drought and repeated heatwaves.

But temperatures and rainfall were not the same everywhere. Type in your postcode to see what summer 2026 was like in your area.

High-pressure weather systems sat over the UK for much of the summer, bringing clear, sunny skies for many parts of the country and creating warm, dry conditions.

But global warming - mainly the result of the burning of fossil fuels - is raising average temperatures in the UK .

This means that any warm spells can reach higher temperatures than the same weather systems of the past.

The Met Office estimates that this summer's average temperature was made about 130 times more likely by human-caused climate change .

Rising temperatures also mean that our vegetation and soils dry out more quickly - which can worsen the effects of low rainfall.

UK summers are expected to become drier on average due to climate change - although when there is heavy rain it could fall in more intense bursts.

Not every summer will be as hot or dry as this one, as weather patterns vary from year to year.

But scientists warn that average temperatures will keep increasing while countries keep adding greenhouse gases to the atmosphere.

articles.title: Why Gen Z is swapping cardio for strength training
articles.summary: Gyms are booming, solitary cardio is out - how workouts are changing.
articles.body:
When Antonia Duffin, 34, started going to the gym, she wanted to lose weight and tone up.

It became such a big part of her life that she decided to become a personal trainer alongside her day job in operations for a supermarket chain - and now runs her own women's gym in Manchester.

"Some of my clients want to feel stronger, some want to get in shape for a baby and some are struggling with other conditions like endometriosis and want to feel better," she says.

Hybrid training, like Hyrox, which is sociable and competitive, seems to have taken over from running on a treadmill or general cardio on a bike, she explains.

Antonia also notes an appetite for more strength training workouts among younger clients, adding: "I think people are now realising the importance of it - we're preventing osteoporosis and things like that."

Do numbers bear that out? And how are workouts across the UK changing?

According to Sport England, more young adults are going to the gym, using exercise machines and weights to keep fit compared to nine years ago.

"Gyms offer broader types of exercise, like resistance training, which can improve body composition and shape more quickly than aerobic exercise training," explains exercise expert Dr Andrew Scott, from the University of Portsmouth.

He says social media is having an impact too. "Lots of people are largely learning from influencers, suggesting 'I can do it, this is what I did and so can you'."

Student Will Seward, 19, started going to the gym when he was at secondary school because he wanted to "get stronger and build up his physique".

His workouts - usually three a week - have changed over time, from using running machines and exercise bikes initially to more explosive training using weights, to help build athleticism.

"It's had a real impact on my day to day life," he says, "improving my mood and making me feel generally healthier."

Barbells, kettlebells, dumbbells and cable machines are all part of the strength training Antonia offers in her gym space, located in a shipping container.

Recent research suggests doing the recommended two hours of strength training each week may offer many of the same benefits as regular aerobic exercise, such as lowering the risk of dying from heart disease or stroke while also protecting the brain and boosting self-esteem.

These benefits are not the only appeal of exercise though. Many say they feel a sense of connection when exercising with other people.

Dr Hussain Al-Zubaidi, a GP, personal trainer and triathlete, says there is now "an enormous ecosystem" for those who are already active, featuring gyms, running clubs, fitness apps, social media and wearable tech.

How different age groups meet overall exercise targets varies.

Among nearly 2 million participants in Our Future Health - a health and lifestyle questionnaire - younger age groups were more likely to do shorter bursts of vigorous activity every week like fitness classes, aerobics or football.

While running has fallen in popularity overall, it is still the most common form of exercise for young men and women - and in the top two activities for adults overall.

And organised, social running is thriving, with children, 20-somethings and over 50s accounting for a growing share of participants in parkruns, which are free to everyone and have over 1,400 events taking place across the UK every weekend.

Prof Esther van Sluijs, professor of behavioural epidemiology from Loughborough University, says community exercise offers social connection.

When working from home is so common, particularly for young people, "easy access to community clubs close to home is very important", she adds.

Gym membership 'like an essential utility bill'

So how much is keeping active costing exercise goers, at a time when budgeting is tight?

More than a quarter of 16-34 year olds say paying for gym membership and keeping fit is a top spending priority, over holidays and eating out, data from UK Active shows - up from a fifth in 2024.

A 2026 survey by the Gym Group found a third of Gen Z spent £26-50 per month on health and fitness, with a quarter spending more than £50.

Events manager Cordelia Sheridan, 27, who exercises four to five times a week at her gym in Battersea, says she treats her £45 gym membership "like an essential utility bill".

"If you go to the pub and you're with a group of mates, you can buy a few pints and easily spend that on a night out," she says.

Living just five minutes walk from her gym makes it easy to get there for 6.30am and exercise before work.

At the gym, she spends 10 minutes on a stair-climbing machine then 35 minutes using weights and machines to strengthen the thighs, hips and lower back.

Before, her routine was all about cardio - but she didn't feel she was getting better or stronger. Now, she says, it's really nice being able to hit targets and lift heavier weights. "I want to go into my 30s being strong."

"And it's also weirdly more sociable," she says.

Persuading people to exercise is about making it the easy, social and enjoyable thing to do, even if it costs, says Dr Al-Zubaidi.

"I think that's why activities like the gym, running clubs and padel have been successful - not because they prevent disease but because they are fun and sociable."

articles.title: Canada prosecutors drop charges against two in Toronto gold heist
articles.summary: Amit Jalota and Ali Raza had their charges dismissed while other cases related to the massive 2023 theft continue through the courts.
articles.body:
Canadian prosecutors have dropped charges against two men accused of being involved in a massive gold heist in Toronto in 2023.

Amit Jalota and Ali Raza both had charges against them withdrawn last week.

More than 6,500 gold bars worth C$20m ($14.5m/£11.6m), were stolen from Toronto Pearson Airport in April 2023, along with millions in cash. A year later, police announced a series of arrests linked to what was the biggest gold theft in the country's history.

Lawyers for both men told Canadian media that their clients had long maintained their innocence and were relieved to be able to move forward with their lives.

They had their lives and livelihoods turned upside-down due to the now dropped charges, the lawyers said.

Both were accused of being in possession of either stolen gold or currency linked to the crime.

"He has been punitively and unreasonably punished for the last three years as he was forced to navigate the criminal justice system and the fall out of these allegations that were publicly broadcasted both nationally and internationally," Jalota's lawyer said in a statement provided to Canadian media.

The heist happened inside a cargo facility at the airport, after the goods arrived on an Air Canada flight from Zurich, Switzerland.

Police allege that someone was able to access the goods by showing a fake airway bill - a document that accompanies shipped items.

A truck was then used to steal the gold, which weighed roughly 400kg (881lb), police said.

Earlier this year, one man was sentenced to four years by a Canadian court for his role in helping plan the theft.

Another man was sentenced to 160 months in prison after pleading guilty in the US to conspiring with others to illegally traffic firearms, according to the US Department of Justice.

He was stopped by police in Pennsylvania with 65 handguns in the trunk of his car. Canadian police alleged money for the guns came from the heist.

Two other accused will face separate trials later this year over charges related to conspiracy to commit theft. Both have said they are not guilty.

articles.title: Iranian president blames US for Middle East conflict while denying nuclear ambitions, offers to dilute uranium
articles.summary: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian claims Tehran will submit its nuclear program to verification and dilute enriched uranium to ease tensions.
articles.body: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian flatly denied Thursday that Tehran wants a nuclear bomb while claiming Iran is willing to submit its nuclear program for international inspection, blaming Washington for the nearly seven-month war in the Middle East and accusing it of blocking diplomacy. Asked point-blank during an exclusive interview on Fox News’ "Special Report," "Do you want a nuclear bomb or not?" Pezeshkian firmly rejected the premise. "Not at all. Not at all. Our martyred, esteemed supreme leader had announced several times that from a religious decree, it is unholy. It is illegal," he told Brett Baier, referencing religious edicts issued against weapons of mass destruction. IRAN 'ALREADY AGREED' TO GIVING UP NUCLEAR WEAPON AMBITIONS, TRUMP REVEALS The Iranian leader's public denial came amid long-term international scrutiny of Iran’s nuclear program and its enrichment of uranium to levels well beyond those typically used for civilian nuclear power. This, in fact, became President Donald Trump's central rationale for launching Operation Epic Fury back in February. On Thursday, however, Pezeshkian went on to indicate that Tehran would be open to lowering its enrichment levels and allowing outside verification as part of an effort to ease nuclear tensions. "So that weapon's mass destruction. We said we’re willing to dilute them. It’s not a big deal. We are willing to submit ourselves to verification," he said.
